The `IllegalStateException` occurred during release builds because R8/ProGuard minification (`isMinifyEnabled = true`) stripped generic signatures and anonymous subclass metadata by default. When `object : TypeToken<List<Book>>() {}.type` is instantiated, Gson inspects `getGenericSuperclass()` to resolve the type argument, which fails when generic signatures are not retained.

The missing rules have been added to [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r5/work/app/proguard-rules.pro):

- Kept generic `Signature` and related attributes (`*Annotation*`, `EnclosingMethod`, `InnerClasses`).
- Preserved `com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken` and its subclasses.
- Preserved model classes (`vn.shelftap.lab.model.**`) so field names and types are not obfuscated or stripped during serialization/deserialization.
